subject: Kinetix dedicated pricing — bridge request & approval needed
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@kinetix.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU pool and throughput guarantees (RFP attached)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency profile. We're preparing the formal RFP and attached version 3 with expected traffic patterns and required SLAs. Two asks up front: can you match the baseline unit economics our incumbent offered (they quoted $3,200/GPU-month for an 8-GPU reserved pool) and can you give a written throughput guarantee for our 400 qps baseline with spike handling to 800 qps?

We'd like to get commercial terms and a draft SOW by next Wednesday so procurement can review. If Redwood can match economics and provide a short transition credit, we can move to an LOI quickly.

Attachments:
- Kinetix_RFP_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Julia
Head of Ops, Kinetix.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@kinetix.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool and throughput guarantees (RFP attached)

Hi Julia — great to meet you yesterday, and thanks for sending the RFP. Looping in Aditya (lead), Marissa (AE), and Diego (SE) to scope.

High-level response: we can provide an 8-GPU dedicated pool with capacity planning that supports your 400 qps steady state and automated burst to ~800 qps using our burst routing + autoscale configuration. We typically guarantee baseline throughput in the SLO with a performance SLA tied to request latency percentiles (p95). That said, we need to confirm the exact model variant, sequence length assumptions in the RFP, and whether KV-cache warmup windows are acceptable as part of the SLO.

On pricing: our standard list for a committed A100-equivalent GPU is $3,600/GPU-month for a 12-month reserved commit. The incumbent rate you noted ($3,200) is within striking distance; given Kinetix is a strategic target and the risk of them staying with the incumbent, I'd like to propose we consider a limited commercial concession: either a one-time onboarding credit plus an introductory discount window, or a slightly shorter commit at an adjusted unit price.

Aditya/Marissa — can you advise on what level of credit / discount we can offer to match the competitor without impacting our pricing guardrails? If this will require exec approval (credits > $30k or >10% off list for an anchor term), please flag and we'll prepare a short green-sheet. Julia, we'll aim to get a commercial draft and SOW by Wednesday pending approvals.

Best,
Steph
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated GPU pool and throughput guarantees (RFP attached) — commercial posture

Team — quick posture suggestion before we formalize:

1) Commercial structure options to present to Kinetix:
   - Option A (match economics): 12-mo commit, 8-GPU pool, $3,200/GPU-month (match incumbent), but require a 9% one-time onboarding credit (applied as invoice credit over first 2 months).
   - Option B (shorter commit): 9-mo commit, 8-GPU pool, $3,000/GPU-month, no onboarding credit, but smaller term.

2) Risk / approval thresholds:
   - Option A discount delta is 11% vs our list ($3,600) and onboarding credit estimate is ~$57,600 (9% of first 2 months at list) — this exceeds our standard delegated approval. We need exec sign-off for credits > $50k or >10% net concession.
   - Option B stays under credit threshold (no credit) but reduces committed term and ARR. Good alternative if execs push back.

3) Technical ask: Diego — confirm whether our burst autoscaling + cache priming can be captured in SLA language (we can guarantee steady-state throughput; burst will be best-effort with documented warm-up windows). Procurement will want a hard guarantee; legal will push back on unlimited credits/penalties.

I'll draft a one-page green-sheet for Rishi that summarizes revenue, margin impact, competitive rationale (reference potential logo, expansion runway), and approvals needed. Marissa — please attach a short pricing worksheet with ARR / TCO scenarios (I started a tab).

-Aditya
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-11T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated GPU pool and throughput guarantees (RFP attached) — pricing scenarios

Attached is the pricing worksheet with three scenarios (sheet tabs: base, match, bridge). Key takeaways:

- Base (list): 12-mo, 8 GPUs @ $3,600 = $345,600 ARR (first year revenue after smoothing).
- Match (Option A): 12-mo, 8 GPUs @ $3,200 = $307,200 ARR; onboarding credit (one-time): $57,600; Net first-year cash $249,600 after credit.
- Bridge (Option B): 9-mo, 8 GPUs @ $3,000 = $216,000 (pro-rated) with potential upsell at renewal.

Recommendation: Present Option A to Kinetix with a conditional credit (applies if LOI by 10/18) to protect momentum. Request exec approval for a one-time onboarding credit up to $60k and an exception to allow 11% net concession for this strategic account.

Attachments:
- pricing_worksheet.xlsx (xlsx)

Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Kinetix bridge credit (conditional)

Thanks for the clear summary. I approve a conditional bridge package to win Kinetix:

- Approve Option A commercial structure (12-mo, 8 GPUs @ $3,200/GPU-month)
- Approve onboarding credit up to $60,000, conditional on signed LOI by 2027-10-18 and acceptance of our standard SLA language that documents warm-up/burst limitations.
- Approval contingent on Legal sign-off on the SOW and Revenue Ops confirming billing treatment.

Finance: please flag any GAAP recognition implications; RevOps: confirm the invoice schedule. Once Legal confirms SOW language, Marissa/Steph can send the commercial draft to Kinetix.

Rishi
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
